Linux Variax prefix reference bytes
====================================

This notice covers the instruction arrays in src/linux_variax_prefix.rs and
nothing else in VariaxWorkbench. Those arrays are test reference data. They
are not a runtime dependency. The application does not link them. The Rust
module that holds them is compiled only for tests.

The arrays are compiled excerpts of Linux sound/usb/line6/variax.c. They are
open-source kernel object code. The message buffers and the activate-template
copy fed to the interpreter are separate inputs. The activate template is the
already committed VARIAX_ACTIVATE constant. The instruction arrays are not
synthetic fixtures.

Windows, each half-open:

- line6_variax_process_message, unpatched and patched, [0x160, 0x240),
  224 bytes each.
- variax_startup, [0x250, 0x309), 185 bytes. The model-byte patch does not
  change this function, so both detached objects contain the same bytes.
- line6_variax_process_message.cold, [0x309, 0x319), 16 bytes. Both detached
  objects contain the same bytes. The 16-byte nop prefix at [0x240, 0x250)
  is not part of either function.

Upstream
--------

SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
Copyright (C) 2004-2010 Markus Grabner (line6@grabner-graz.at)

The source file also contains MODULE_LICENSE("GPL"). The SPDX identifier
selects GNU GPL version 2 only. The "any later version" example in the GPL
appendix does not apply to this file. The license text is
third_party/notices/GPL-2.0-only.txt.

Pinned source: https://github.com/gregkh/linux
Tag: v7.2.15
Commit: 497791a0a96b866d90add64041c47acdff49cae6
Path: sound/usb/line6/variax.c
SHA-256: f623cd628440ee3208f857a97a462799260c068633774e4b3ff2cad9107c62af

That commit is the corresponding source for the unpatched excerpt. This
repository does not vendor variax.c. The same commit supplies driver.h,
midi.h, and midibuf.h, which variax.c includes. Those headers use the same
SPDX identifier and copyright. Their SHA-256 values are
6bdbf42547971ee457d67a02b742ef342ffc7ca9a675d5f298ef21f6e1c3f8cf,
8928524fc89e772aec5cfabf6eb568d33f43cd0216a195bdaf44cd9a9209e060, and
c56dfe4fe244119b98dbcae55197d60267533be0d512e4c22d6ec9d613599f80.

Patched excerpt
---------------

The second array is the same function after
docs/linux-variax-model-bytes.patch. That patch was recorded in commit
002471c655378b84f31b72ea92eb76db9280942b on 2026-11-15. It is the local
modification of the pinned file. Apply it to the pinned variax.c to recover
the source of the patched bytes.

Build recipe
------------

Both objects were produced by a detached module build. It wrote only under a
temporary directory and did not install the module.

Compiler, from the installed tree include/generated/compile.h:
gcc (GCC) 16.2.1 20260810

Command:
make -C /lib/modules/7.2.15-1-omarchy/build M=<temporary-directory> modules

Out-of-tree makefile:
obj-m += snd-usb-variax.o
snd-usb-variax-y := variax.o

Both objects report vermagic:
7.2.15-1-omarchy SMP preempt mod_unload

The unpatched object was the unmodified pinned file. The patched object was
that file plus the patch above. Each .text image is 793 bytes (0x319).
Unpatched .text SHA-256:
3eae27ccbea3a6ca067a86faf4ade9c713702234b369df20e1391fbe4ff9849d
Patched .text SHA-256:
3d3aa8f53ab2dc4a97bfffa37e73cffea55d4354ab31bbffdb4186b75c058454

Excerpt SHA-256, window [0x160, 0x240):
unpatched 68dea14f9600a5c5cb820c35f2a9ab3a65e71f112b0dbc5017d8e0146ad3d7a1
patched   e9ef1f53b7e6ce3c52ac39581dd4fe1bdccd634d56b4358c505916b301cd1a6b

Excerpt SHA-256, window [0x250, 0x309), both objects:
82e84447105d6a8db79880fa7f340b969f7efa8ff14713a419ddaf3238a65db2

Excerpt SHA-256, window [0x309, 0x319), both objects:
e2134e1ab91cd5c4c2735fb7f5030aa3b8b351bfe574ff083a671501ac3c6401

The cold body's `movq` immediate is the unresolved relocation
R_X86_64_32S `.rodata+0x158`. The source literal at that site is
"VARIAX reset\n". This repository does not vendor that string. The harness
keeps the object immediate, which is zero, and does not load `.rodata`.

The generated .ko files stay outside this repository.
